paired_intervention_hypotheses.scope: Prospective paired action intervention; no measured effect or rollout
paired_intervention_hypotheses.intended_difference: Change only actor 0's first console request into wait. After three suffix calls, actor 1's east-move mask should differ. The following identical east actions should enter and exit the north threshold only in the requested branch.
paired_intervention_hypotheses.source_derived_timing: Call 1 accepts a request and sets timer 2. Calls 2 and 3 mature it after movement, so the first movement opportunity under the new topology is call 4.
paired_intervention_hypotheses.branch_legality_note: The downstream probe action may be legal in only one branch. raw_step deterministically converts any illegal action to wait. This is intentional prospective mask/transition probing, not a replay success claim.
